title: LCSD says City Ticketing system illegally accessed by hackers, preliminarily 約130萬 users’ data may be involved
date_note: The LCSD press release of 25 November gives no earlier day for the announcement; it says the contractor reported the incident to LCSD on 24 November.
summary: Hong Kong’s Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) said the City Ticketing system, owned and developed by an outsourced contractor, was illegally accessed by hackers. RTHK’s headline gives a preliminary figure of 約130萬 users’ data. LCSD says the data includes usernames or names, phone numbers and email addresses; identity document details are not stored and credit card information is masked. It reported the case to police and regulators.
plain: Hong Kong’s LCSD says its City Ticketing system was illegally accessed. A preliminary figure of 約130萬 users’ names and contact details may be involved, per RTHK.
exec: A Hong Kong ticketing system was breached; preliminarily 約130萬 users’ data may be involved, per RTHK.
geo_basis: LCSD, the Hong Kong government department that announced it; no city-level victim location stated
org: Leisure and Cultural Services Department (Hong Kong)

evidence.quote: 初步涉約130萬使用者資料

validation.note: LCSD press release on info.gov.hk read, plus RTHK relaying it.
